mapper.insert: insert into SIMULATION_ITEM( SIMULATION_ID, SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY, SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME, SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY, SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT, APPLY_START_DATE, APPLY_END_DATE, POLICY_ID, RECURRENCE_TYPE, IS_DELETED ) values ( #{simulationId}, #{simulationItemCategory}, #{simulationItemName}, #{simulationItemExpenseCategory}, #{simulationItemApplyAmount}, #{applyStartDate}, #{applyEndDate}, #{policyId}, #{recurrenceType}, false )
mapper.select: select SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY as simulationItemCategory, SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME as simulationItemName, SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY as simulationItemExpenseCategory, SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT as simulationItemApplyAmount, APPLY_START_DATE as applyStartDate, APPLY_END_DATE as applyEndDate, POLICY_ID as policyId, RECURRENCE_TYPE as recurrenceType, IS_DELETED as isDeleted from SIMULATION_ITEM where SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} and IS_DELETED is false
